pages.title: Continue
pages.text: The Continue screen of Sonic the Hedgehog (Sega, 1991) has a short tune of about nine seconds. Sega Retro credits it to Masato Nakamura. According to Wikipedia, Sonic earns continues in the bonus stages by collecting 50 rings.

pages.title: Back in the sequel
pages.text: The Continue tune of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992) starts all 101 of its melody notes on exactly the same beats as this one in the recordings of both games in this player, so the sequel reuses its rhythm.
